title: board.pages: a module's page in the board's Fleet sidebar (docs/design/board-ui.md "Modules"). The page is a module view: an MCP Apps resource (ui://<module>/…, text/html;profile=mcp-app) its own connection serves, shown in a sandboxed frame that calls only the tools listed here, as the owner. The same view opens in the owner's Claude through the owner MCP. Compile adds `module`.

id.description: the page's address, #/fleet/<id>; unique across modules

title.description: its name in the sidebar and the page header

order.description: its place after the core entries (Agents, Apps, Modules, Reviews), ascending

connection.description: one of this module's own MCP connections: it serves the view and the tools

tools.description: the tools the view calls: read or write tools of `connection` (never destructive). A write tool called by the owner returns its typed settings change for the board to save as the owner's own
